To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
8-shaped spiral inductors on HRS substrates are promising for silicon IC applications.
the 8-shaped inductor is an interesting alternative to octagonal/rectangualr inductors in silicon RF IC design.

8-shaped spiral inductors have been designed and measured, that they have higher inductance than expected from classical octagons and rectangles, that they are well described by an electrical model and that this model can be used in RFIC designs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and optimization of high quality factor inductors on a HRS substrate for RF applications.
the development and optimization of a new type of high quality monolithic inductors for silicon RF IC design.
the design and characterization of high-quality monolithic 8-shaped inductor for silicon RF IC design.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
8-shaped monolithic inductors on HRS substrate are a very good choice for high frequency RF applications.
8-shaped monolithic inductors are the most promising candidates for RF silicon IC design.
the 8-shape is a very good compromise between classical octagonal and rectangular inductors, leading to higher inductance and lower parasitic resistance values.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
8-shaped spiral inductors on HRS substrate are very attractive for RF applications.
8-shaped devices are very promising for RF applications on silicon substrates, and they could be considered for the design of RF circuits.
8-shaped devices lead to a better inductor design in terms of area occupation, inductance and quality factor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed inductors can be used in RF applications where high quality factors are required, such as for low noise amplifiers (LNAs), oscillators or phase-locked loops (PLLs) for example.
8-shaped monolithic inductors are a good alternative to classical octagonal/ rectangular inductors in silicon RF IC designs.
, for a given area, 8-shaped inductor is the most efficient solution to design inductors on HRS substrates.
